title: Typed Direct Groundwater Interface, Datum, Sign, Units & Convergence Policy
read_only_authority_audit: qualified prescribed-bottom-head mode-5 owner contracts and source
hard_contract: Typed direct-coupling quantities must keep H_SWAP, H_GW, q_SWAP, q_GW, r_H and r_q distinct.
The interface head datum and any SWAP-native pressure-head conversion must be explicit; no pressure-head/elevation-head equivalence may be assumed silently.
q_SWAP is positive leaving SWAP; q_GW is positive leaving groundwater; r_q=q_SWAP+q_GW.
Direct interface mass pairing is exact q_GW=-q_SWAP and has no tolerance.
The coupling window is generic finite [t0,t1] with no midnight/day semantics.
H_interface_tol is explicit, finite, positive and provenance-bound; there is no numeric default.
H_interface_tol is not automatically equivalent to Richards temporal H_budget, nonlinear solver tolerance, predictor perturbation, regulatory threshold or application H_app.
Mass conservation is outside the allocatable head-accuracy budget and cannot be relaxed by this policy.
implementation_scope: Materialize typed direct groundwater interface data and validation.
Materialize explicit datum/unit conversion only after live owner semantics are audited.
Materialize a fail-closed head-convergence policy carrier with provenance requirements.
Provide pure/deterministic residual and conversion operations sufficient for downstream F-GC18 through F-GC22 composition.
qualification_plan: exact q_GW=-q_SWAP assignment and r_q identity
NaN/Inf/missing datum or provenance fail closed
head residual and flux/mass residual remain type-separated
missing or non-positive H_interface_tol fails closed
source allowlist and no unrelated production delta
